currentState.focus: Proved sum_fixedPoints_eq_factorial via Burnside's lemma. 2 sorries remain (card_perm_fixing_point, weighted_partition_identity).

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: All proofs done. 0 sorries, 0 axioms. 12 theorems in DerangementsOQ02OQ02.lean
builtItems: sum_fixedPoints_eq_factorial proved via Burnside's lemma: ∑_σ |Fix(σ)| = |orbits| · |Perm(Fin n)| = 1 · n! = n!
filter_eq_fixedBy_card (private): (filter fun x => σ x = x).card = Fintype.card (fixedBy (Fin n) σ) via Fintype.card_subtype + Equiv.subtypeEquiv
4 native_decide verifications (n=1,2,3,4) for sum_fixedPoints and weighted_sum
card_perm_fixing_point: orbit-stabilizer gives |{σ : σ x = x}| = (n-1)! in DerangementsOQ02OQ02.lean:103
weighted_partition_identity: fiberwise identity via Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to in DerangementsOQ02OQ02.lean:196
insights: Equiv.Perm acts transitively on Fin n: IsPretransitive (Perm α) α instance in Algebra.Group.Action.End
From IsPretransitive + Nonempty: MulAction.pretransitive_iff_unique_quotient_of_nonempty gives Unique Ω → Fintype Ω (via Unique.fintype) → Fintype.card_unique gives 1
Key pattern: (pretransitive_iff... |>.mp inferInstance).some extracts Unique from Nonempty(Unique ...)
card_perm_fixing_point ({σ | σ x = x}.card = (n-1)!) remains sorry; approach via orbit-stabilizer is valid but needs API work to convert stabilizer.card to filter.card
weighted_partition_identity (∑_k k·C(n,k)·D(n-k) = n!) remains sorry; needs sum-exchange/bijection between perms-with-k-fixed and C(n,k)·D(n-k)
card_perm_fixing_point proved via orbit-stabilizer: n·|stab(x)| = n! = n·(n-1)!, so |stab(x)| = (n-1)!
weighted_partition_identity proved via double counting: k·C(n,k)·D(n-k) = k·|A_k| = ∑_{A_k} fp(σ) → ∑_σ fp(σ) = n!
mathlibGaps: No direct API for Fintype.card (stabilizer (Perm (Fin n)) x) = (filter fun σ => σ x = x).card
